view.title: Administrator release console
view.subtitle: Use a conservative release gate to review runtime, core journeys, compliance entry points, and platform-readiness status.
view.adminOnlyHint: Administrator-only surface. Admin identity is determined by the environment allowlist of phone numbers or account IDs.
view.redirectingBody: If the current identity is not in the allowlist, this page will return to the account center automatically.
view.loadingBody: Loading runtime diagnostics and local manual-confirmation records.

knownWarnings.title: Workspace root warning caused by multiple lockfiles
knownWarnings.body: Next.js currently warns about workspace-root inference. Before release we need an explicit turbopack.root or the extra lockfile removed.

knownWarnings.title: baseline-browser-mapping data is stale
knownWarnings.body: The current build warns that browser baseline data is outdated. The corresponding dev dependency should be refreshed before release.

groups.title: Build and base configuration
groups.summary: Verify build output, bilingual resources, and the administrator allowlist first.

items.title: Frontend production build passes
items.description: The current H5 routes must compile successfully under next build.

items.title: Account and release-check resources are bilingual
items.description: Release-check pages must keep full Chinese and English resource coverage.

items.title: Administrator allowlist reviewed manually
items.description: Confirm the phone numbers or account IDs configured for this environment to avoid exposing the release console by mistake.

groups.title: Core user journeys
groups.summary: Cover the key loops for assessment, OCR, report, timeline, and check-in.

items.title: Assessment-to-report flow smoke-checked
items.description: Manually walk through questionnaire completion, report navigation, and recommendation rendering.

items.title: OCR upload and confirmation flow smoke-checked
items.description: Manually confirm the upload page, processing state, confirmation page, and enrichment results.

items.title: Saved plan and check-in persistence smoke-checked
items.description: Verify recommendation saving, check-in accumulation, and persisted session behavior after refresh.

groups.title: Compliance and trust entry points
groups.summary: User-facing policies, feedback, export, deletion, and administrator isolation must stay explicit.

items.title: Privacy, export, and deletion entries are exposed
items.description: The account center should surface privacy, export, deletion, and transparency-note pages.

items.title: Help and feedback entries are exposed
items.description: FAQ, feedback form, and feedback-record routes should all be reachable.

items.title: Release-console entry is hidden from non-admins
items.description: Manually confirm that the account center does not show the release-check card for ordinary identities.

groups.title: Platform readiness
groups.summary: WeCom and Web skeletons stay blocked until their foundations are delivered later in this node.

items.title: WeCom callback skeleton is connected
items.description: Provide a WeCom callback placeholder route and downgrade-safe adapter boundary.

items.title: Web dual-shell foundation is connected
items.description: Provide a desktop shell foundation without breaking the current H5 behavior.
